user.title: Hasar: connect to the add-on
user.description:
**Add-on connection**

On Home Assistant OS / Supervised the add-on is found automatically through Supervisor. If everything is fine, this step is skipped.

If the add-on cannot be found, enter its internal address manually.

If the add-on is not installed yet, install Hasar from Settings → Apps → App store.

data_description.addon_url: Filled automatically when possible. This is the add-on's internal address, not the station address.

confirm.title: Hasar: add-on already paired
confirm.description:
The Hasar add-on is already paired with this station:

**Add-on:** `{addon_url}`
**Station:** `{plugin_url}`

Add it to Home Assistant?

To pair a different station, first change the pairing in the Hasar add-on panel.

pair.title: Hasar: pair the station
pair.description:
**Station pairing**

Add-on: `{addon_url}`

1. Make sure the `hasar-agent` plugin is installed and running on the station.
2. Find the station IP address in your local network — for example, in your router or in YAM.
3. Read the pairing code on the station via ADB or SSH:
   `adb shell cat /data/quazar/yam/data/hasar-agent/pairing.json`
4. Enter the station address and the code below.

The code is one-time. After successful pairing the file is deleted.

More details: https://github.com/Thedamem/hasar

data_description.station_host: For example, 192.0.2.10. You can also paste the full https://192.0.2.10:8443 address.
data_description.plugin_port: 8443 by default. Change only if the plugin listens on another port.
data_description.pairing_code: The code from the code field in pairing.json on the station.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Hasar add-on. Tried: {tried}. Make sure the add-on is running, or enter its hostname manually.
error.timeout: The add-on did not respond in time. Check that it is running.
error.cannot_pair: Could not pair the station. Check the IP address, pairing code and that the plugin is running.
error.invalid_host: Invalid station address. Enter an IP address or hostname, for example 192.0.2.10.
error.addon_missing: The Hasar add-on is not installed in Supervisor. Adding the repository to the store is not enough: open Hasar in the store, click Install, then Start. If it runs as a standalone container, enter its address manually.
error.addon_stopped: The Hasar add-on was found ({hostname}), but it is not running (state: {state}). Start it and try again. Tried: {tried}.
error.bad_response: The address answered, but it is not Hasar. Check the address manually. Tried: {tried}.
error.not_supervised: Home Assistant is running without Supervisor (for example, Home Assistant Container). Automatic add-on discovery is unavailable — enter the add-on address manually, for example http://<HOST_IP>:8097.
error.supervisor_unavailable: Could not read the add-on list from Supervisor. Enter the add-on address manually or check Supervisor.
error.cannot_connect_pairing: Could not connect to the Hasar add-on for pairing. Make sure the add-on is running and try again.

abort.already_in_progress: Hasar setup is already running in another window.
